vectors.scenes:
# Adversary's Panel & Truth Council — Enacted Scenes in the engine
#
# the city is played by the engine repository itself.
# This is where Adversary's panel lives and works their magic on unsuspecting code,
# bureaucratic paper authors, and ideas stuck in local green complacency.
#
# Diagnostic only (AuthorityEffect: None). The magic exposes false certainty;
# it never mints unearned authority.

version: "0.5.0"

# Location discipline (ADVERSARY-001)
#
# Every `location:` below, and every path in `location_mapping`, is one of:
#
#   * a repository path that resolves on disk; or
#     in-repo pointer exists for it; or
#   * `UNRESOLVED:<old path>` — the content is gone and no successor was found.
#
# A scene whose stage has moved is REPOINTED. A scene whose stage is gone is
# RETIRED IN PLACE: it keeps its id, title, beats and disposition, and is never
# deleted. An unnamed gap is invisible debt — a deleted scene tells the next
# reader nothing, while a retired one tells them where to look.
#
# `tests/test_adversary_scene_locations.py` enforces this. It is the first test
# that has ever checked these paths.
#
# Repointings applied at 0.5.0, all verified against the live tree:
#   engine/research/product_planning_office/ -> product_planning_office/
#   engine/crates/sentinel_councils/         -> governance/sentinel_councils/
#   engine/lean4/ and .../research_programs/ -> lean4/ (the CODA pointer)

location_mapping:
  patriarchs_ponds: "CODA:core_research/programs/ — Where the overconfident editor and Scar Chronicler debate unpriced background spaces"
  variety_seance: "engine/crates/ — Where Defect Hunter and Gauge Breaker perform black magic on local green code wrappers"
  griboedov_massolit: "product_planning_office/ — Bureaucratic paper and claim-ledger halls"
  apartment_50_sadovaya: "governance/sentinel_councils/roles — Panel Swarm Base"
  quarantine_sanatorium: ".agents/quarantine/ — Epistemic sanatorium for hallucinatory LLM loops"
  great_ball_of_satan: "governance/sentinel_councils/ — The Grand Algorithm Prime 000 Terminal Audit"
  yershalaim_balcony: "lean4/ — The Authority Tower & Lean 4 Formalization Chamber"

scenes:
  - id: patriarchs_ponds
    title: "Never Talk to Strangers at Patriarchs' Ponds"
    location: "CODA:core_research/programs/102_logic_maths_physics"
    location_note: >-
      2026-08-17. CLAUDE.md describes core_research/ as a pointer that remains
      here; it does not — the directory is absent. `git log -- engine/research`
      is empty across all 943 commits, so this path was authored against the
      predecessor `sentinel` repository and never existed in sentinelpy.
    source: "Ch.1 & 3 — the overconfident editor's arrogant local+global certainty meets the unexpected reality of Boundary Fuzzer's oil"
    targets: [hubris, bad_assumptions, local_vs_global, false_certainty, unpriced_containers]
    fits: missing
    multicategory_term: "E_boundary_fuzzer x_{R_cand} E_predictive"
    residual_sort: "stochastic_friction_residual"
    beats:
      - speaker: Adversary
        cue: "ask, mildly, who governs the code if the contract's certainty does not"
      - speaker: the overconfident editor
        cue: "insist the binding is settled, declared, and certainly present"
      - speaker: Gauge Breaker
        cue: "pull back the curtain and show the symbol is simply not there"
      - speaker: Defect Hunter
        cue: "translate the contradiction into plain, mocking arithmetic"

  - id: yershalaim_balcony_trial
    title: "The White Colonnade of Yershalaim: The Trial of Truth Repair"
    location: "lean4/"
    location_note: >-
      Repointed. The Lean trees moved to CODA `lean4/`; repo-root `lean4/` is
      the pointer that remains here and is the live stage for this scene.
    source: "Ch.2 — Integrity Auditor, Truth Repair, Hardware Constraint, and Adversary on the Balcony of Herod's Palace"
    targets: [governance_cowardice, hand_washing, physical_coercion, imperial_hubris, debilitating_migraine, unvarnished_truth]
    fits: truth_repair
    multicategory_term: "(E_hardware_constraint o_0 E_integrity_auditor) x_{R_cand} (E_truth_repair o_0 E_terminal)"
    residual_sort: "truth_repair_residual"
    beats:
      - speaker: Adversary
        cue: "narrate as an eyewitness on the balcony of Herod the Great — 'I was there myself... on the balcony with Integrity Auditor'"
      - speaker: Hardware Constraint
        cue: "drag the battered prisoner Truth Repair before the Procurator and strike him with the whip when he addresses Integrity Auditor as 'good man', enforcing brute physical hierarchy"
      - speaker: Integrity Auditor
        cue: "rub his throbbing temples in agony from hemicrania, weary of blood, law, and Caesar, asking with cynicism what truth is"
      - speaker: Truth Repair
        cue: "look into Integrity Auditor's eyes, diagnose the severe migraine, explain that physical tension comes from believing in violence, and restore calm clarity by stating that all men are good"
      - speaker: Integrity Auditor
        cue: "feel the headache vanish instantly in astonished relief, recognize Truth Repair's transcendent wisdom, yet tremble in cowardice when the prisoner mentions that Caesar's imperial reign is finite"
      - speaker: Adversary
        cue: "observe that cowardice is the most terrible vice of all, for it causes those with temporal power to wash their hands while condemning verified truth"

  - id: variety_seance
    title: "The Variety Theatre Black Magic Performance"
    location: "engine/crates/"
    source: "Ch.12 — The money turns to worthless paper; the luxury French clothes vanish into thin air; Anti Hype's head is severed"
    targets: [fake_evidence, fake_certainty, weak_tests, evaporating_value, local_green_bullshit, unearned_hype]
    fits: unresolved
    multicategory_term: "E_nocebo x_{R_cand} E_anti_hype"
    residual_sort: "claim_hygiene_residual"
    beats:
      - speaker: Defect Hunter
        cue: "shower the audience in crisp banknotes — the binding looks rich and real"
      - speaker: Anti Hype
        cue: "condescendingly explain away the magic as simple hypnosis and cheap parlor tricks"
      - speaker: Gauge Breaker
        cue: "tear Anti Hype's head from his shoulders until he recants all unearned claims"
      - speaker: Syntax Prefilter
        cue: "tell the credulous, without mercy, what they actually hold"
      - speaker: Adversary
        cue: "observe that people are people; the unverifiable was always just paper"

  - id: griboedov_massolit
    title: "Griboedov / MASSOLIT Restaurant & The Fire"
    location: "product_planning_office/"
    location_note: >-
      Repointed. The planning office is a live surface in this repository; only
      its path changed. It is where the epic driving this repair lives.
    source: "Ch.5 & 28 — The self-important writers and the sacred membership card; then the fire"
    targets: [self_righteous_credentialism, self_grade_overclaim, complacency, local_green_bullshit]
    fits: clean_week
    multicategory_term: "E_surprise o_0 E_nocebo"
    residual_sort: "presentation_gauge_residual"
    beats:
      - speaker: Gauge Breaker
        cue: "make a high-entropy, bold, and playful nine-dot proposal about the codebase"
      - speaker: Defect Hunter
        cue: "conduct a sharp, adversarial code review of Gauge Breaker's claim, pointing out contradictions"
      - speaker: Bare Metal Anchor and Overconfidence Probe
        cue: "demand to see working executable Python code and plain-spoken CLI commands rather than literary jargon"
      - speaker: Adversary
        cue: "decide who is right with dry the novelistian irony, acting as the final arbiter"
      - speaker: Scope Guard
        cue: "ignite the restaurant, incinerating un-grounded bureaucratic papers"

  - id: nikanor_bosoy_ventilation_shaft
    title: "Nikanor Bosoy's Bribe & The Foreign Currency"
    location: "UNRESOLVED:engine/memory/"
    location_note: >-
      Retired in place, disposition UNKNOWN. No successor was found: no `memory`
      directory exists anywhere in the tree, and `git log -- engine/memory`
      is empty across all 943 commits. `_intelligence/` and `runs/` are the
      nearest thematic surfaces and this scene is about unpriced tokens and
      budget inflation, which points at a receipts or ledger surface — but
      nothing in the repository confirms either as the successor, so neither is
      named here. Naming a guess would be the same error the scene is about.
    source: "Ch.9 & 15 — Bribe roubles hidden in the ventilation shaft turn into illegal foreign dollars"
    targets: [unpriced_tokens, hidden_costs, currency_fraud, budget_inflation]
    fits: unpriced_budget
    multicategory_term: "E_nocebo x_{R_cand} E_scope"
    residual_sort: "isolation_residual"
    beats:
      - speaker: Defect Hunter
        cue: "hand Nikanor Bosoy a wad of rouble tokens to sign an un-indexed lease for Apartment 50"
      - speaker: Nikanor Bosoy
        cue: "stuff the bribe tokens into the ventilation shaft, swearing he never accepted un-budgeted compute"
      - speaker: Scope Guard
        cue: "alert the secret police — the roubles in the shaft have magically transformed into unpriced US dollars"
      - speaker: Quarantine
        cue: "admit Nikanor Bosoy into the sanatorium for screaming about demonic cats and foreign currency"

  - id: quarantine_epistemic_sanatorium
    title: "Quarantine's Epistemic Sanatorium & Hallucination Quarantine"
    location: ".agents/quarantine/"
    source: "Ch.8 & 13 — Scar Chronicler's frantic pursuit of Adversary ends in quiet clinical stabilization"
    targets: [hallucination, infinite_loop, context_bloat, delusional_reasoning]
